name: NC-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Foushee's large fundraising and outside spending advantage
model.rationale: The D+23 seat, incumbent advantage, and overwhelming financial edge leave no evidence pointing toward an upset, and prediction markets agree at 96% for Foushee. With no polls or expert ratings available, the fundamentals-based margin stands.
model.watch: Any late polling showing the Republican within single digits, or a major outside spending surge for Ganorkar, would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Valerie Foushee seeks a second term in a Durham-area district that leans Democratic by 23 points. She has raised over $900,000 and benefits from roughly $2.4 million in outside support, while Republican Max Ganorkar has raised about $12,000 and shows no outside backing. A Libertarian is also on the ballot but lacks visible resources.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and money, both of which point strongly to Foushee. Prediction markets price her at 96%, consistent with a comfortable expected margin in the mid-20s.
